_doc: Speeches for the 'Speeches by Soviet Leaders' shelf. Read by tools/import_soviet_speeches.py. text: wikisource page title, or marxists URL. youtube: candidate ids, first playable+embeddable wins. start/end in seconds (end null = to the end).

speeches.title: III, Коммунистический Интернационал (1919)
speeches.author: Ленин В.И.
speeches.blurb: Lenin's gramophone record of March 1919 on the founding of the Communist International, set against the First and Second Internationals.

speeches.title: Обращение к Красной Армии (1919)
speeches.author: Ленин В.И.
speeches.blurb: Recorded in March 1919, Lenin's appeal to Red Army soldiers in the Civil War, urging them on against the Whites and their foreign backers.

speeches.title: Памяти Я. М. Свердлова (1919)
speeches.author: Ленин В.И.
speeches.ws: Памяти Председателя ВЦИК товарища Я. М. Свердлова (Ленин)
speeches.blurb: A short recorded tribute of March 1919 to Yakov Sverdlov, chairman of the Soviet executive committee, who had died that month.

speeches.title: Сообщение о переговорах по радио с Бела Куном (1919)
speeches.author: Ленин В.И.
speeches.ws: Сообщение о переговорах по радио с Бела Кун (Ленин)
speeches.blurb: Lenin's recorded account of his March 1919 radio exchange with Béla Kun, leader of the new Soviet republic in Hungary.

speeches.title: О крестьянах-середняках (1919)
speeches.author: Ленин В.И.
speeches.blurb: A 1919 recording explaining who the 'middle peasant' is and why the Party sought an alliance with him rather than coercion.

speeches.title: Что такое Советская власть? (1919)
speeches.author: Ленин В.И.
speeches.blurb: Lenin's best-known recording, from March 1919: a plain account of what Soviet power is and why he believed it would win everywhere.

speeches.title: Как навсегда спасти трудящихся от гнёта помещиков и капиталистов (1920)
speeches.author: Ленин В.И.
speeches.ws: Как навсегда спасти трудящихся от гнёта помещиков и капиталистов (Ленин)
speeches.blurb: Recorded in 1920 as the Civil War wound down, a call for a 'red army of labour' built on the same discipline that won the war.

speeches.title: О работе для транспорта (1920)
speeches.author: Ленин В.И.
speeches.blurb: A 1920 recording urging workers and peasants to rebuild the shattered railways, the bottleneck of the whole economy.

speeches.title: О трудовой дисциплине (1920)
speeches.author: Ленин В.И.
speeches.blurb: Recorded in 1920: why the Reds won the Civil War, and why the same self-sacrifice would now defeat economic ruin.

speeches.title: Беспартийные и Советская власть (1921)
speeches.author: Ленин В.И.
speeches.blurb: A 1921 recording asking workers and peasants to put forward honest non-Party people to help run the country.

speeches.title: О продовольственном налоге, или продналоге (1921)
speeches.author: Ленин В.И.
speeches.blurb: Recorded in April 1921, Lenin explains the new tax in kind that replaced grain requisitioning at the start of the NEP.

speeches.title: О потребительской и промысловой кооперации (1921)
speeches.author: Ленин В.И.
speeches.blurb: An April 1921 recording on consumer and producer co-operatives and the part they were to play under the NEP.

speeches.title: О погромной травле евреев (1919)
speeches.author: Ленин В.И.
speeches.blurb: Lenin's 1919 recorded speech against antisemitism and pogroms: the enemy of the workers is capital, not the Jews.

speeches.title: О концессиях и о развитии капитализма (1921)
speeches.author: Ленин В.И.
speeches.ws: О концессиях и о развитии капитализма (Ленин)
speeches.blurb: Recorded in April 1921, a defence of inviting foreign capitalists to work Soviet resources under concession.

speeches.title: О проекте Конституции Союза ССР (1936)
speeches.author: Сталин И.В.
speeches.blurb: Report to the Extraordinary Eighth Congress of Soviets, 25 November 1936, presenting the new 'Stalin Constitution'. Only parts of the recording survive.

speeches.title: Речь на предвыборном собрании избирателей (1937)
speeches.author: Сталин И.В.
speeches.blurb: Speech to his constituents at the Bolshoi Theatre, 11 December 1937, on the eve of the first elections to the Supreme Soviet.

speeches.title: Речь на параде на Красной площади (1941)
speeches.author: Сталин И.В.
speeches.ws: Выступление И. В. Сталина на параде 7 ноября 1941 г.
speeches.blurb: Speech to the troops on Red Square, 7 November 1941, with the Germans at the gates of Moscow; many marched straight on to the front.

speeches.title: Выступление по радио 9 мая 1945 года
speeches.author: Сталин И.В.
speeches.blurb: Radio address of 9 May 1945 announcing Germany's surrender and the end of the Great Patriotic War.

speeches.title: Речь на предвыборном собрании избирателей (1946)
speeches.author: Сталин И.В.
speeches.blurb: Speech of 9 February 1946 at the Bolshoi Theatre, summing up the war and setting out the post-war economic plan.

speeches.title: Речь на XIX съезде КПСС (1952)
speeches.author: Сталин И.В.
speeches.blurb: His last public speech, 14 October 1952, addressed to the foreign Communist delegations at the Nineteenth Party Congress.

speeches.title: Выступление по радио 22 июня 1941 года
speeches.author: Молотов В.М.
speeches.ws: Выступление В. М. Молотова по радио 22 июня 1941 г.
speeches.blurb: The radio announcement of the German invasion at noon on 22 June 1941, ending with the words 'Our cause is just. The enemy will be defeated. Victory will be ours.'

speeches.title: Заявление об отставке (1991)
speeches.author: Горбачёв М.С.
speeches.ws: Заявление Президента СССР об отставке от 25.12.1991
speeches.blurb: Televised address of 25 December 1991 in which the last Soviet leader resigned as President of the USSR, days before the union was dissolved.
